what: P4 baselines on Panel B: spec section 5, descriptive only

interpretations.rows_items_1_4: items 1-4 apply to the five clean rows (dda_native, dda_crop308, cospy_native, fire_native, aeroblade); the two H5 rows were scored on Panel B test rows only (no luma, no threshold reals), so item 5 is what is reported for them
interpretations.difference_sign: a paired difference is ours minus the baseline (S2-D or full_bank minus the row); positive means ours is higher
interpretations.tpr_point: TPR at the union threshold is a point value: section 5 gives CIs for AUC, AP, the FPRs and the macros, not for TPR (as P3's descriptive section)
interpretations.slices: 'every Panel B test slice' = the 4 unseen, E7's 6 VAE slices against the E7 test reals, E7 luma FLUX.1 against the E7 luma test reals; E8 has no reals, so only its TPR is reported
interpretations.macro_fpr: the mean of the E4 and E5 achieved FPRs at the row's own union threshold
interpretations.h5_clean_reference: DDA clean under item 5 is dda_native on the same Panel B test rows
interpretations.h5_versus_s2d: S2-D seed 0 under the same condition minus DDA under it, paired
interpretations.bootstrap_calls: every reported interval is one call of p3_analyze.bootstrap (fresh generator, seed 2026); calls are independent, so they may run in parallel processes without changing any value

labels.home_benchmark: E7 is DDA's home benchmark (DDA-COCO, built by DDA's authors); DDA trained on MSCOCO train, E7's reals are val2017 (spec section 6)
